messages:
Aria N: heads-up — seeing a weird pattern on /chat-stream: token P95 jumped ~40% for the last 45m but aggregate GPU SM occupancy is lower than usual. VRAM used is high and one MIG slice shows very uneven utilization. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/rt/perf-overview :eyes:
Javi M: can you paste the token-latency breakdown panel? also did kernel-selector roll hit that window? last kernel change was ~2h ago.
Aria N: pasted query snippet: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))` — filter=route="/chat-stream". panel shows p95 jump aligning with a rollout at 15:20 UTC. seq distribution shifted >512 tokens.
Priya S: sequence length shift + kernel selector = classic. when seq>512 we fall back to matmul_v1 which is slower on our MIG config. can we add a small sampling profiler on hot slices? e.g. `perf_event` traces per-MIG and attach to token_id window.
Javi M: confirmed on my run: profiler shows kernel_matmul_v1 exec_time +28% for batch sizes 4-8 when seq>512. also KV cache hit rate dropped ~12% (likely because of different prefix batching). snippet from perf: ```
# sample
kernel=matmul_v1 seq=768 batch=6 time_ms=12.3
kernel=matmul_v2 seq=256 batch=12 time_ms=4.1
```
Aria N: interesting — KV prefetch seems to be evicting more often. I saw KV cache eviction spikes in same window. panel: `sum(rate(kv_evictions[1m])) by (node,mig_slice)` shows hot-evict on slice-3.
Lina G: maybe the batcher is preferring small batches for long seqs, causing more active KV entries per request. propose adding a per-route batcher policy override: max_batch_tokens=8192 for /chat-stream to force larger batching when sequences are long.
Priya S: agree to test a canary. also request a new dashboard panel: per-route token-waterline heatmap (time vs token-length buckets) so product team can see which routes shifted. suggested query: `sum by (route, token_bucket)(rate(token_count[5m]))` and heatmap binning at [0-128,129-512,513-1024,>1024].
Javi M: action items: 1) add a short profiler run on slice-3 (I can run now), 2) create a temporary canary batcher override for /chat-stream (Lina?), 3) add two dashboard panels: per-route token-length heatmap + per-MIG kernel mix (matmul_v1 vs v2). I can open PR for kernel-metrics exporter.
Lina G: I can flip the canary in staging (will script it). tagging @Zack-bot to kick off a perf job.
Zack-bot: deploy notice — triggered run: perf-sampler-job-171850 on staging queued by Lina G. ETA ~12m. :rocket:
Aria N: thanks — once perf run finishes can we grab traces and compare p95/p99 per-token bucket and KV-hit delta? I want a timeline panel that overlays deploy events with token p95.
Priya S: will add overlay to dashboard and also set an alert: token_p95(route="/chat-stream") > 200ms for 10m -> page. set on-call to eng-runtime-lead.
Javi M: if profiler confirms kernel fallback is the cause, we should add a kernel-selection unit test that simulates seq distribution >512 so future rollouts catch it. low-effort guard.
Aria N: perfect. leaving this thread open for perf-run logs. will post results + screenshots. thanks all :thumbsup:
